stem: A grower proposes correcting every visible deficiency pattern by increasing the suspected macronutrient without checking the rest of the program. What is the strongest criticism?
choices: Single-element increases can miss nutrient interactions, root-zone availability problems, and developmental context
Every visible symptom always comes from exactly one macronutrient
Developmental stage has no role in nutrient interpretation
rationale: Mineral nutrition is interactive and context-dependent. A single-element response based only on appearance can overlook availability, antagonism, total concentration, and plant stage.
